purpose: Document terminal civil administration without generating municipality geometries or claiming measured complete land coverage.

native_scope.legal_coextensiveness: The territory of the Principality forms one single commune under Constitution Article 78.

evidence.title: Constitution de la Principauté
evidence.version: Official online consolidated Constitution retrieved 9 November 2026; Articles 78-79 verified in cached source
provisions: Article 78: one commune comprising the Principality's territory

authorities.uncertainty: Legal coextensiveness does not verify the precision or measured land coverage of an existing country geometry. Planning quarters are not additional communes.

provisions: Articles 1-2: sovereign state and state functions exercised by the Governatorato
Articles 15-16, 20: executive, general administration and public services

authorities.uncertainty: No lower independent civil municipal tier is demonstrated by the examined current framework; this is an organizational inference, not a literal statutory declaration of zero subdivisions. Curial bodies, church parishes and extraterritorial properties are not municipalities. Boundary precision and measured land coverage remain separate.
